title: Quantitative Superexponential Bounds for van der Waerden Numbers
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。

abstractEnglish: We prove that there are absolute constants c > 0 and K0 such that $`W_r(k)\gt k^{ck\lfloor\log_2 r\rfloor}`$ for every $`k\ge K_0`$ and r ≥ 2. Consequently $`W_r(k)^{1/k}\to\infty`$ for each fixed r ≥ 2, giving a quantitative positive resolution of Erdős's superexponential-growth question, including the two-color case.
titleEn: Quantitative Superexponential Bounds for van der Waerden Numbers
titleZh: van der Waerden数的定量超指数界

details.overview: 稿件研究van der Waerden数W_r(k)的增长下界。作者声称存在绝对常数c>0与K₀，使得对所有k≥K₀和r≥2有W_r(k)>k^{ck⌊log₂r⌋}；由此对每个固定r≥2，W_r(k)^{1/k}趋于无穷。摘要表示这定量地正面解决了Erdős关于超指数增长的问题，包括两色情形。该结果属于Ramsey理论与组合数论，但作为AI产生的研究手稿，尚未经独立审查或同行评议。
